full_details: Midsummer is past, and Kemp has not been told. Friday's frame stood yesterday. You did not hear that it had been taken down. At two you played. The reckoning took two minutes: eight shillings a share. You entered it as received, and you did not open the coffer and did not make a new balance. Then the door was shut. The Mayor has written to the Lord Treasurer, and he will blame the playhouses next. James said he is the Lord Chamberlain's man and will open his own doors, and that was not taken as the vote. John wants it written that you played old comedies and kept the peace. Bryan would send to Kettleby at Greenwich before the Mayor's letter gets there. Margery, called in, said the yard is dry tinder, and that she has stood that stair nine years. Kemp had no jest. You said the only safe house in London tomorrow is a shut one, and that it is Sunday. No order has shut the house. You agreed to meet Monday and see what Monday is. The wardrobe chests were locked with a second iron. The licensed books go to Aldermanbury with Heminges. Garnish carries the parts. John set the question of the country roads for July, and nobody answered it. Richard was in the room and did not decide.
one_sentence: You played, took eight shillings as received, and agreed to meet the sharers on Monday.
title: Eight shillings received, and a meeting on Monday
